details:
Add the ability to move and scale certain elements of profiles, nameplates, and other UI changes like the Desktop UI that you want to see.

The game already has blocks/containers that neatly contain certain aspects of the profile, and not everyone wants to see the avatar someones wearing in the profile for example, and you can even add more blocks/widgets for more niche cases and people would love it that way, and this would let you appease people because everyone can make their own UI they enjoy.

I understand its supposed to be "Parity with the website", but the only reason website works is because people can choose to zoom out on a browser, i personally zoom out to 80%, the current length and width of the menu was not made for the website ui in mind.

In my personal opinion, Profiles should not be required to scroll to reach important information like Groups, while seeing the avatar someone's wearing through the profile is less important to me

My idea would be similar to Phone app widgets.

========

**Examples in attachments:**

**Picture 1** showcases a default profile, the default profile could be the same as how the default is at the moment in build 1921 instead, with edit profile moved to the top center, and the time removed.

===

**Picture 2** showcases a new Edit-Mode, which allows you to move, scale, and select widgets, by selecting a widget, you can click & hold to drag, and scale the overall size with the joystick or scroll wheel, could have pre-set positions in determined slots nearly identical to the Phone Widgets mentioned previously, or completely free moving with the restrictions of the menu boundaries and too-close boundaries with other widgets.

On a widget select, you are given 2 buttons:

An Edit button, if the widget has editable features like a bio, links, badges, etc.

A trash button, if you wish to remove that widget from the profile board.

===

**Picture 3** showcases the Add-Widget tab, accessed by first going to Edit Profile, then clicking the + on the left of it, allowing you to add all previous widgets to your profile view if you so desire, and more widgets can easily be added here, like the original large button layout of the Invite and Request buttons.

===

**Picture 4** showcases the 'Current Location' widget being added, automatically moved for the first time, and selected to edit.

Some widgets may not have editable features, so the edit button is removed.

And you could have a delete limit of 1 major widget, like the 'Profile' widget.

========

*Huge note!* this idea is not for Synced profile settings, like how Profile Decorations, Icons, or Colors being synced and sent over to the player viewing your profile!

These are completely in-client settings that the player viewing the profile doesn't see, its completely personal settings for every profile *you* view.
title: New UI Update?: Add customizable Widgets instead of massive UI changes.
